mapper.sql: WITH month_fee AS ( SELECT icam10_fund_cd AS fund_cd , icam10_std_date AS std_date , EXTRACT(MONTH FROM icam10_std_date)::int AS month_no , icam10_fee * icam10_fx_rate AS fee_amt , CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(icam10_std_date,'YYYY') = #{preYearText} THEN 'PRE' WHEN TO_CHAR(icam10_std_date,'YYYY') = #{yearText} THEN 'CURR' END AS year_type FROM icam10_fee WHERE icam10_company_id = #{companyId} AND icam10_fee_type = '20402' /*(20402:미지급운용보수)*/ AND icam10_rmk_cd = 'P00' /*(P00:보수 및 수수료(비용)발생)*/ AND icam10_std_date BETWEEN (#{preYearText}||'-01-01')::date AND (#{yearText}||'-12-31')::date UNION ALL SELECT ifi31_fund_cd AS fund_cd , ifi31_std_date::date AS std_date , EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ifi31_std_date::date)::int AS month_no , ifi31_occ_fee AS fee_amt , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ifi31_std_date,1,4) = #{preYearText} THEN 'PRE' WHEN SUBSTR(ifi31_std_date,1,4) = #{yearText} THEN 'CURR' END AS year_type FROM ifi31_fund_fee INNER JOIN ifi29_am_corp_mapping ON ( ifi29_if_cd = ifi31_if_cd AND ifi29_am_corp_cd = ifi31_am_corp_cd AND ifi31_std_date BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ifi29_start_date,'YYYYMMDD') AND COALESCE(TO_CHAR(ifi29_end_date,'YYYYMMDD'),'99991231') ) WHERE ifi29_company_id = #{companyId} AND ifi31_cur_cd = 'KRW' AND ifi31_std_date BETWEEN (#{preYearText}||'0101') AND (#{yearText}||'1231') ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS fee_id , fund_cd ||' '|| fnd02_fund_nm AS fund_name , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 1 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee1 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 1 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee1 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 2 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee2 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 2 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee2 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 3 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee3 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 3 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee3 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 4 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee4 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 4 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee4 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 5 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee5 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 5 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee5 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 6 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee6 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 6 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee6 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 7 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee7 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 7 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee7 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 8 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee8 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 8 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee8 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 9 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee9 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 9 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee9 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 10 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee10 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 10 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee10 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 11 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee11 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 11 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee11 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' AND month_no = 12 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS beforefee12 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' AND month_no = 12 THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS afterfee12 , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'PRE' THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_beforefee , SUM(CASE WHEN year_type = 'CURR' THEN fee_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_afterfee FROM month_fee LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ast33_fund_cd , MAX(CASE WHEN ast33_fund_trans_cd = '2' THEN ast33_date ELSE null END) ast33_in_date , MAX(CASE WHEN ast33_fund_trans_cd = '1' THEN ast33_date ELSE null END) ast33_out_date FROM ast33_fund_trans WHERE ast33_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY ast33_fund_cd ) t2 ON ast33_fund_cd = fund_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT fnd01_fund_cd, fnd02_fund_nm FROM fnd01_fund_code INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id ) ) WHERE fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} ) fnd ON fnd01_fund_cd = fund_cd WHERE std_date >= COALESCE(ast33_in_date ,'2000-01-01') AND std_date < COALESCE(ast33_out_date ,'9999-12-31') GROUP BY fund_cd, fnd02_fund_nm
